name: app-store-play-reviews-scraper
title: iOS App Store & Google Play Reviews Scraper and API
description: Use to export Apple App Store and Google Play reviews for given apps and countries. Input: App Store IDs or links and Play package names or links, plus countries. Returns one row per review: rating, text, ISO date, app version, country, developer reply. $0.12 per 1,000 reviews.
